entry.title: and i'll wake up in the morning to exactly who you are
entry.summary:
Author: stendhal

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 7,800Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 5

Summary: It’s impossible to know how long he’s been here. There’s a method he has to track the days, but, he only started when the days started to mix, started to mess with his head. What he does know is that time... it moves strange, here, and where here is, that’s another mystery all together. No one knows, no one seems to care. If he had to say... it settles inside of him like New York; not like the sleeplessness of the city, the barely contained life that pulsed against every square inch of the city's boundaries all hours of the day⸻no, this place... it’s like the forgotten stretches of cracked and faded highways that lead into little towns, helpless to the passing years, helpless to their collapse: rural, dilapidated, molasses slow. They say suicides go to hell, the kind with brimstone and demons, but, perhaps, here, this... this watered-down bleakness, where the days and night mesh together in an endless timeline, and there’s nothing else to do but go through the motions of living... He throws his cigarette on the ground, unlocks his car. Maybe this is the real hell, after all.Sometimes, death is nothing more than a second chance.
